'''Klee-klee nuts''' were a type of [[Nut/Legends|nut]] that were sometimes cooked by roasting.<ref name="MedStar II" /> By [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]],<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref> a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] named [[Barriss Offee/Legends|Barriss Offee]] had smelled the nuts while they were roasting and found the aroma to be pleasant. During that [[Standard year/Legends|year]], while Offee was in her quarters at [[Republic Mobile Surgical Unit/Legends|Republic Mobile Surgical Unit]] [[Republic Mobile Surgical Unit 7|7]] during a [[Battle of Drongar|battle]] fought between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Drongar/Legends|Drongar]] as part of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the Jedi was reminded of the nuts' roasting smell by an odor that she believed to originate from a malfunctioning [[power amplifier]] in her room's [[Comm unit/Legends|desktop comm unit]].<ref name="MedStar II" />

==Behind the scenes==
Klee-klee nuts were mentioned in ''[[MedStar II: Jedi Healer]]'', a [[2004]] novel written by [[Steve Perry]] and [[Michael Reaves]].<ref name="MedStar II" />
